def factor_range_exhaustion_intraday_reversal(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(df_copy["close"], df_copy["open"])
    range_ = df_copy["high"] - df_copy["low"]
    range_mean = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).mean()
    range_std = range_.rolling(20, min_periods=20).std(ddof=1)
    range_zscore = ((range_ - range_mean) / range_std.replace(0.0, np.nan)).fillna(0)
    vol_ma = df_copy["volume"].rolling(60, min_periods=60).mean()
    vol_ratio = (df_copy["volume"] / vol_ma.replace(0.0, np.nan)).clip(0.0, 2.0).fillna(1.0)
    signal = -intraday_ret * range_zscore * vol_ratio
    signal_ema = signal.ewm(span=3, min_periods=1).mean()
    df_copy["factor_range_exhaustion_intraday_reversal"] = signal_ema.fillna(0)
    return df_copy["factor_range_exhaustion_intraday_reversal"]
description: A large daily price range combined with a sharp intraday decline (negative intraday return) and elevated volume relative to the 60-day average indicates panic selling exhaustion. The factor expects a short-term reversal upward. The interaction is smoothed by a 3-day EMA to reduce noise.
